title: Kagamine Len — To Give Them Strength〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Street SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huff... Huff...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Len, shouldn't we take a break...?
We've been singing since this morning.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
No, I changed my mind...!
Just one more time from the top!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: From the top?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Of course, I'll keep singing if you want to, Len. But...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You seem really anxious today for some reason. What's the rush...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It's just...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I wanna be able to help Akito and the others more.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Compared to you and MEIKO, I feel like I haven't really done all that much.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: When Akito came over to SEKAI to ask for advice the other day...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Luka...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You sounded really amazing just now, Akito...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But I feel like you can do a lot more! Like, pow!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I wasn't able to say anything, let alone give him good advice...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Len...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: There was also that time before. You and MEIKO cheered them up after the group they'd been doing events with all scattered...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Even KAITO gave them some really good advice regarding their new songs.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Not to mention how Rin was there for An when she found out the truth about Nagi.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Compared to all of you guys, I haven't been able to give good advice or teach them anything useful...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
So, I wanna learn to at least sing better!
I wanna be a source of encouragement for them!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I wanna be able to help them even just a little bit...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I see...
I understand how you feel, Len.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But I think what you said about not having done anything for them needs some correction.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Some correction?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You may not realize it, but you've helped them quite a lot already, Len.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You think so...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We decided to see what was going on after hearing Len and Miku singing...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
But I guess we came at a bad time.
I feel kinda bad for eavesdropping.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah.
Also, he's really been feeling that way...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But he's helped us so much...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, he has. His cheerfulness and passion have been a great source of encouragement for us.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
That includes the way he sang just now.
I can't help but feel a little fired up.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We can't really sit around and do nothing after witnessing that, can we?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, not really... We came to take a quick break, but we ended up getting a nice, little push.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Thanks, Miku...
I feel a little better now.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But I still wanna sing that thing again from the beginning. How do you feel?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You're so stubborn.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
But I'll join you.
We can sing until you feel satisfied.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yes! Thanks again, Miku!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I'm gonna get good and really learn to help them!
